name: toggle-group
useFor: Use type="single" for one view or filter among a few (Live, Failed, All) and type="multiple" for filters that combine. Use variant outline with spacing 0 for a joined bar of white keys. Prefer Tabs when each option shows its own panel.
constraints: More than six options in the tray
Blue filled keys for the chosen option
source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the header's trays and the segmented control)
title: Toggle Group
description: The header's frosted tray of options with the chosen one a white key and a blue label, or separate white keys.
